The most recent updates completed in the repository are:

1. **GitHub Actions Agent Setup** ([`.github/workflows/antigravity-agent.yml`](https://github.com/mwamss/Chemsha-Bongo/blob/main/.github/workflows/antigravity-agent.yml)):
   - Configured the workflow to run the Antigravity agent automated environment.

2. **Server & Lifecycle Hardening, Config Modularization** (commit `7fee41f`):
   - **Game Lifecycle & Teardown**: Added [`abortCurrentGame`](https://github.com/mwamss/Chemsha-Bongo/blob/main/src/core/GameManager.js#L56-L68) and state guards (`isRoundActive`, `isCountdownActive`) in [`GameManager`](https://github.com/mwamss/Chemsha-Bongo/blob/main/src/core/GameManager.js) and [`cancelCountdown`](https://github.com/mwamss/Chemsha-Bongo/blob/main/src/ui/ScreenManager.js#L90-L100) in [`ScreenManager`](https://github.com/mwamss/Chemsha-Bongo/blob/main/src/ui/ScreenManager.js) to prevent ghost timers or overlapping countdowns when exiting or navigating away.
   - **Navigation & Shortcuts**: Integrated lifecycle cleanup into [`App`](https://github.com/mwamss/Chemsha-Bongo/blob/main/src/app.js#L237-L270) when pressing <kbd>Escape</kbd>, using the sidebar, or navigating back home.
   - **Modularized Tailwind**: Extracted inline design tokens from [`index.html`](https://github.com/mwamss/Chemsha-Bongo/blob/main/index.html) into [`styles/tailwind.config.js`](https://github.com/mwamss/Chemsha-Bongo/blob/main/styles/tailwind.config.js) and added safe area padding utilities in [`styles/main.css`](https://github.com/mwamss/Chemsha-Bongo/blob/main/styles/main.css#L83-L90).
   - **Local Server Security**: Bound [`serve.py`](https://github.com/mwamss/Chemsha-Bongo/blob/main/serve.py#L12-L33) specifically to loopback (`127.0.0.1`) with socket address reuse enabled.
   - **Documentation**: Updated [`README.md`](https://github.com/mwamss/Chemsha-Bongo/blob/main/README.md) explaining runtime architecture, zero external game frameworks, and procedural Web Audio synthesis.

Here is a breakdown of the latest work completed:

### 1. Agent Automation & Workflow
* **Antigravity Agent Setup** ([`.github/workflows/antigravity-agent.yml`](https://github.com/mwamss/Chemsha-Bongo/blob/main/.github/workflows/antigravity-agent.yml)): Configured the GitHub Actions workflow to enable automated agent runs on the repository.

---

### 2. Core Game Stability & Lifecycle Fixes (Commit `7fee41f`)
* **Lifecycle Teardown & Edge Cases**:
  * Added [`abortCurrentGame`](https://github.com/mwamss/Chemsha-Bongo/blob/main/src/core/GameManager.js#L56-L68) and lifecycle guards (`isRoundActive`, `isCountdownActive`) in [`GameManager`](https://github.com/mwamss/Chemsha-Bongo/blob/main/src/core/GameManager.js) to prevent ghost timers or multiple rounds overlapping.
  * Added [`cancelCountdown`](https://github.com/mwamss/Chemsha-Bongo/blob/main/src/ui/ScreenManager.js#L90-L100) in [`ScreenManager`](https://github.com/mwamss/Chemsha-Bongo/blob/main/src/ui/ScreenManager.js) so active countdown intervals are cleanly halted when navigating away.
  * Tied escape key listeners and drawer navigation in [`App`](https://github.com/mwamss/Chemsha-Bongo/blob/main/src/app.js#L237-L270) to abort games cleanly.

---

### 3. Architecture & Styling Modularization
* **Tailwind Token Extraction**: Moved theme and color configurations from [`index.html`](https://github.com/mwamss/Chemsha-Bongo/blob/main/index.html) into an external configuration file: [`styles/tailwind.config.js`](https://github.com/mwamss/Chemsha-Bongo/blob/main/styles/tailwind.config.js).
* **Safe-Area Utilities**: Added `.pb-safe` and `.pt-safe` rules in [`styles/main.css`](https://github.com/mwamss/Chemsha-Bongo/blob/main/styles/main.css#L83-L90) for notch and home-indicator clearance on mobile devices.
* **Server Security**: Updated [`serve.py`](https://github.com/mwamss/Chemsha-Bongo/blob/main/serve.py#L12-L33) to bind strictly to loopback (`127.0.0.1`) with TCP address reuse enabled.
* **Branding & Assets**: Embedded authentic 3D squircle icons and favicons in [`assets/`](https://github.com/mwamss/Chemsha-Bongo/blob/main/assets) and [`index.html`](https://github.com/mwamss/Chemsha-Bongo/blob/main/index.html#L14-L21).
